finalText:
The default-batch run is done. It used the default batch size of 4 and accepted four records.

The implementation and the earlier diagnostic files (`work/temporary.ndjson`, `work/temporary-checkpoint.json`, `temporary-report.json`) are unchanged.

I did not run the `rex session rename` step from the session setup. The bash tool only allows `node` commands, so I couldn't run `rex` from here.
